# dsh-ontology — DSH 本体库 Python 平台层

> uv workspace 维护 5 个平台包 + 平台应用，FastAPI 监听 8093；与 Java dsh-java-ontology 同契约、同表结构。

Key capabilities:
- base: 配置、双库会话、租户中间件、JWT、统一结果、Harness 插件协议
- flow: 认证授权、动态本体、工作台、个人/公共/全局知识汇聚
- qa: 报告与问数
- viz: 图谱查询与展示
- metric: 指标采集与统计
- platform: 聚合 5 包，FastAPI 8093

Tech stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (async), asyncmy, PyJWT, bcrypt, uv workspace
Version: workspace and all packages 0.2.0
Repository: git@github-linlannet:linlannet/dsh-ontology.git

Build / Test:
- Install: `uv sync --all-packages`
- Run:     `uv run dsh-ontology` (port 8093)
- Health:  `GET /health`
- Tests:   none yet (pytest baseline planned in docs/0.2.2)

Runtime:
- Port:        8093 (`DSH_PLATFORM_PORT`)
- Deploy mode: `split` (`DSH_DEPLOY_MODE`)
- SIIS DB:     `dsh_java_siisdb` (`DSH_SIIS_DB_URL`)
- Onto DB:     `dsh_java_ontodb` (`DSH_ONTO_DB_URL`)
- JWT:         `DSH_JWT_SECRET`
- Harness:     `DSH_HARNESS_BASE_URL` (default http://127.0.0.1:8090)

Baseline:
- 37 SQLAlchemy models
- 107 HTTP endpoints
- dual database engines
- response shape: raw on success, `{code, msg, data}` on errors

Structure:
- packages/base/src/dsh_onto_base        config, db, security, middleware, plugin, result
- packages/flow/src/dsh_onto_flow        sys, ontology, workspace, global
- packages/qa/src/dsh_onto_qa            report, qa, task
- packages/viz/src/dsh_onto_viz          graph view
- packages/metric/src/dsh_onto_metric    metrics
- apps/platform/src/dsh_ontology         app.py, main.py
- docs/0.2.2                             alignment spec / design / tasks / release notes

Docs:
- README.md / README.en.md
- AGENTS.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- docs/0.2.2/spec.md
